extras.name: Pao Yue-Kong Library — 2021 appearance reconstruction
reconstruction_limits: All metre dimensions and level profiles except source owner coordinates are reconstruction estimates; no readable dimension chains in the research plans.
Six numbered levels do not certify storey-height convention.
Unseen north/roof details bounded estimates. No full interior layout/furniture reconstruction claim.
The source polygon is an owner/plan scale constraint, not a repeated wall outline for six extrusions.
Neighbor information building local375 remains outside this model. No ownership expansion from 2006 partial-floor use.
2021 reference images must never be copied into public source, embedded textures, or model material images.
lod_protected: Level silhouettes and diagonal setbacks
Portico and all exterior apertures
Canopy curve/ribs and round column silhouettes
Slanted west glazing
Pergola gaps, rails and return walls
No removing eastern small-window reveals into flat decals

lod_protected_geometry.comparison: Actual decoded oriented triangles, material and normals for every retained semantic label; only allowlisted whole groups may be absent

modern_material_scope: All actual present loaded PBR/alpha/transmission/IOR/volume/attenuation properties compared; absent optical features are not invented and photometric correctness is not certified
decoder: Actual locked project Three GLTFLoader and MeshoptDecoder, CPU only
limitations: Exact triangle comparisons concern exported reconstruction geometry, not architectural measurement accuracy.
Authored LOD is verified by retained semantic geometry and finite probes; no global collision, navigability or photometric proof.
Compression-only LOD means no triangle reduction; no low-poly optimization is claimed.
Native and browser acceptance require separate actual reviews.
